The name is also used to describe kind and compassionate individuals, emphasizing the importance of mercy and empathy in Arab culture.

Muslims believe that Allah is Al-Rahman (The Most Merciful) and Al-Rahim (The Most Compassionate), and the name Rajiya is a reminder of this attribute. In times of hardship and trials, the name Rajiya provides comfort and reminds Muslims to turn to Allah for His mercy and compassion.
